criterion: When Call samples are returned, the timeline chart shows call state, service technology, and signal strength across the test duration.
reason: Focused live check on 2 November: the built-in expanded Call analysis view for 5 October 2026, 19:35:02 displays Call initiated (CI), Connected (CC) and Call ended (CE) annotations over the signal-strength timeline spanning the 70-second test. The readable returned samples show Idle, Off Hook and Connected transitions; the chart marks initiation, connection and end. The source asks for call state over time, without prescribing a separate continuous state series or lane. The prior Unverified interpretation imposed that extra presentation requirement. Service technology is shown as Service in the same analysis view, accepted by the user. This is a source-aligned reassessment with a fresh chart capture, not a new full attempt.
